blocks.text: James Reid described his upcoming horror film “Haunted Carnival” as the most physically and emotionally demanding project he has worked on so far. During the film’s mini press conference on Wednesday, Nov. 11, Reid said the Regal Entertainment production pushed him to explore his limits as an actor. “It’s been the most physically and emotionally demanding project I’ve done so far. Screaming, crying, running, chasing, falling. It wasn’t easy,” he said. Reid also recalled how he became part of the project, which marks his first official entry in the Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) and his first film with Regal Entertainment. […]...
